body: Open-source observability for your GenAI or LLM application, based on OpenTelemetry
plain_description: **See how your LLM application is performing and where issues occur.** Instrument LLM providers, vector databases, and frameworks to collect traces and other observability data. Send that data to supported monitoring tools such as Datadog, Grafana, or Honeycomb.
technical_description: OpenLLMetry is a set of OpenTelemetry extensions and a Traceloop SDK for observability in LLM applications. It provides instrumentations for LLM providers, vector databases, and frameworks, and exports standard OpenTelemetry data to supported observability destinations. The README says SDK and instrumentation telemetry collection was discontinued in version 0.49.2 and above.
title: OpenLLMetry
